sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row no_prebuilt_image_shadows_the_agent_dockerfile; Internal Quality Checks annotation of the same row)
evidence: Frozen task/task.toml [environment] (lines 22-26) contains only build_timeout_sec=600.0, network_mode="public", cpus=2, memory_mb=4096; there is no docker_image key anywhere in task.toml (grep for 'image' and 'docker_image' over the frozen task returns no task.toml hit) and [verifier.environment] likewise only sets network_mode. The [environment] block is byte-identical in keys/values to the frozen template task.toml. environment/Dockerfile has active build steps (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim; apt-get install; npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1; COPY instructions/ and assets/; git init of /app), so the Dockerfile is the effective agent image and nothing shadows it; no compose file exists that could substitute an image. Counterexample probes: a prebuilt-image shadow would require a docker_image key, which is absent; a conforming alternative (Dockerfile-only build) is exactly what is shipped. This is a static config row, so no runtime measurement is required for it.
